payload.name: Hermetic Pytest Conftest Guards
payload.description: Enforce hermetic unit-test execution via session and autouse fixtures wired from apps/sandbox-executor/tests/conftest.py that block outbound network sockets, GitHub write commands, host ~/.holon mutations, and ambient credential leakage.

steps: Register modular guard modules from apps/sandbox-executor/tests/conftest.py rather than relying on individual tests to mock external boundaries.
Block unintended outbound network connections via apps/sandbox-executor/tests/network_guard.py while permitting explicit loopback or opted-in integration tests.
Intercept mutating GitHub CLI invocations via apps/sandbox-executor/tests/gh_write_guard.py and protect host state via apps/sandbox-executor/tests/holon_dir_guard.py.
Scrub ambient tokens and redirect temporary directories via apps/sandbox-executor/tests/credential_env.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/fast_tmp_dirs.py.

known_pitfalls: Importing modules that capture os.environ or Path.home() at import time before autouse fixtures run can bypass environment isolation.
Disabling guards globally for one integration test weakens regression detection across the entire unit suite.
Writing test fixtures into the repository root or real ~/.holon directory causes cross-test flakes under pytest-xdist.
